resources.string: This is a trade: how long the app looks for a server before it settles on one. Turbo is enough on most networks.
Takes the first server that answers. Use it when you just need to be online.
Collects several working servers and keeps the fastest one. Recommended.

Only dials servers measured to actually carry a tunnel, never a guessed neighbour. With MASQUE-in-MASQUE or WARP×2 it also keeps the two hops in different ranges, which is what changes your exit address.
Only accepts a server that carries a real request all the way through. For heavily filtered networks, where the tunnel connects but nothing loads.
